models.name: Model A: Steady RANS Pump Flow Solver (k-ω SST)
models.what_it_computes: Time-averaged 3D velocity, pressure, viscous shear rate, and wall shear distributions throughout the rotating assembly and volute under specified operating points.

models.name: Model B: Eulerian Hemolysis Scalar Transport
models.what_it_computes: An advected hemolysis index field driven by local shear exposure and residence time, yielding volumetric hemoglobin release rate and outlet-averaged hemolysis metrics.

models.name: Model C: Lagrangian Particle Damage Accumulation
models.what_it_computes: Trajectory-resolved residence times and cumulative red-blood-cell damage along pathlines, producing distributions of exposure dose and hotspot identification.

mechanisms.name: M1: Boundary-layer shear on blades and shroud
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Sustained near-wall viscous shear contributes to sublethal and lethal red-cell damage as fluid glides along rotating and stationary surfaces.

mechanisms.name: M2: Tip-leakage and rotor–stator interaction peaks
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Localized high-shear transients in the gap and wake regions generate short-duration but intense stresses implicated in hemolysis bursts.

mechanisms.name: M3: Recirculation-driven residence time in the volute
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Slow-moving zones extend cumulative exposure, amplifying damage even at moderate shear and elevating outlet plasma-free hemoglobin.

deviation.detail: All credibility factors are scored per model–mechanism on a 0–4 scale (0=not met, 1=limited, 2=adequate, 3=strong, 4=compelling) and summarized numerically.

expected_decision.outcome_source: Collectively, the assessment supports use of the three-model suite to inform acceptance of operating points within the stated map, subject to caution when interpreting tip-leakage–dominated peak exposures and with the recognition that hemolysis coefficients remain the dominant source of input uncertainty.
rationale_keywords: hemolysis coefficients remain the dominant source of input uncertainty

datasets: in-vitro hemolysis loops using anticoagulated porcine blood
high-resolution laser Doppler anemometry in a transparent pump replica
residence-time mapping in the volute using dye and particle tracking in a blood analog
acceptance_criteria: The decision the models must inform is whether to accept the operating range of a centrifugal blood pump spanning 2–5 L/min at differential pressures of 80–120 mmHg without additional bench testing at every operating point.

The critical-shear volume fraction is intended to be less than 1.0% across the operating map, acknowledging that very small fractions can still contribute through repeated transits but are less likely to dominate overall damage.
For the hemolysis rate, acceptance is set relative to a reference pump and an absolute ceiling of 40 mg/dL increase over a 2-hour run.

name_keywords: RMS differences 14 Pa and mean biases below 8 Pa
Model A within 20% of median LDA-inferred values
0.31 s vs 0.34 s mean; 0.58 s vs 0.55 s 95th percentile
CFD (age-of-fluid and Model C) vs dye/particle tracking
